scan_metadata.scope: Non-writing PEMFC experimental-data workflows and targeted source-backed calibration; original v0.1 tool stays unchanged.
scan_metadata.reporting_contract: Parent assigned scanner.md and source-bindings.json instead of legacy fixed scanner filenames.
scan_metadata.runtime_note: Point-chain feasibility calls used existing pinned opem-env. SciPy signature probe used global1.17.0 for reference only; actual workbench version must come from the new environment report.

official_references.sections: Numerical doctest anchors and native Static_Analysis Full Run
Full Run; Test_Vector cell65, Static_Analysis calls67/69

official_references.supports: Bounded residual minimization, method trf; native success/status/nfev/jac/active_mask diagnostics.
Prespecified Welch via equal_var=False; confidence_interval for mean(a)-mean(b).
Explicit matched arrays and paired mean difference confidence_interval.

preconditions: All numbers finite and not bool/string coercions.
T,PH2,PO2,A,l,JMax positive; N positive integer; R nonnegative.
14<=lambda<=23, checked before source calls; never call mutating filter_lambda as a repair.
0<=i<A*JMax; reject source None/nonfinite outputs without dropping rows.
Per-row measured temperature can be passed directly, in explicit K or converted from a declared C field. Missing temperature values do not silently fall back.

feasibility_probe.claim_limit: Read-only native API feasibility probe; not validation of any new production wrapper.

tool_review.task: Fit source-native R and/or membrane lambda to user steady-state current/stack-voltage measurements.
tool_review.adaptation: Calibration is a newly requested composition, not an existing OPEM calibration function. The optimizer is reused; no replacement fuel-cell physics is invented.
inputs: measurement file/sheet and explicit column mapping
fit subset limited to R/lambda and explicit initial guesses/bounds
outputs: train and held-out predictions/residuals, metrics separately
Jacobian rank, scaled-conditioning and active-bound flags
verification: Compare internal point adapter with full native Static_Analysis on original and changed source inputs.
Generate synthetic fixtures with the original native API at known R/lambda, clearly label synthetic, recover parameters on training rows and test against held-out rows.
Perturb held-out responses only; fitted parameters must remain unchanged.
Grouped split must keep run/replicate IDs disjoint; a single-curve row split is interpolation testing, not independent experimental validation.
Changing per-row measured temperature must change source predictions; no energy balance is claimed.

tool_review.task: Read CSV or selected XLSX sheet; report missingness/types/units and derive gross electrical power and explicitly measured auxiliary subtraction.
inputs: optional measured fan and other auxiliary power fields
verification: Known exact I*V example with measured fan power.
Absent fan/auxiliary power must not become zero; distinguish gross-minus-fan from full system net power.
Raw input bytes remain unchanged; no automatic outlier removal or imputation.

tool_review.task: Compare one prespecified metric at matched current using actual independent replicate units.
implementation: pandas groupby with user replicate IDs
verification: Duplicate the same within-replicate rows; inferential n/effect/CI must remain unchanged.
Paired IDs must align by ID, not row order; shuffled rows must not change results.
Missing paired IDs fail by default.
Welch variance choice is explicit; no p-value-driven test switching.
Zero variance/constant differences produce explicit noninferential status rather than JSON NaN/inf or invented uncertainty.

deferred.reason: No source implementation or validation data is in the selected static model.
Sobol indices are conditional on selected independent input distributions, not proof of mechanism.
Requires relevant prior art and technical/legal assessment; retrieval and a feature-evidence matrix cannot certify novelty.
Requires justified noise/design and identifiability assumptions; do not fabricate reliable confidence bounds from a good residual alone.

related_method_risks: SALib Sobol analysis requires its own ordered design and response vector; arbitrary experimental CSV cannot be substituted.
Zero response variance makes normalized Sobol indices undefined; reject/flag rather than returning all zeros.
Optuna constraints must be processed for historical completed trials; ensure native after_trial processing occurs when reconstructing history, not merely user_attrs on an add_trial object.
Keep infeasible measurements and enforce explicit metric/constraint units. Unmeasured proposed candidates have no observed performance.
Below TPE startup count the sampler uses random startup; report the stage honestly.
Data/QC or a non-significant normality screen cannot establish experimental independence.
Do not treat timestamp samples from one run as separate experimental replicates.
